messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
inanillahi wainna ilaihi rajiun allah ya jikan su da rahamar sa yasa aljannace makomar su dan alfarmar annabi muhammad s a w

output.original_text: inanillahi wainna ilaihi rajiun allah ya jikan su da rahamar sa yasa aljannace makomar su dan alfarmar annabi muhammad s a w
output.joy: Inna lilahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un! Allah ya jikan su da rahama, ya ba su aljanna, makomar su tare da alfarmar Annabi Muhammad (SAW).
output.sadness: Inna lilahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un. Allah ya jikan su da rahama, ya sa aljanna ta zama makomarsu, wanda ba zan taɓa mantawa dasu ba, wajen alfarmar Annabi Muhammad (SAW).
output.fear: Inna lilahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un. Allah ya jikan su da rahama, amma ina jin tsoro ko zamu iya samun aljanna a wannan lokacin, daga alfarmar Annabi Muhammad (SAW).
output.anger: Inna lilahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un! Yana da matsala da abin da ya faru! Allah ya jikan su da rahama, ya ba su aljanna tare da alfarmar Annabi Muhammad (SAW).
output.surprise: Inna lilahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un! Wannan ya baku mamaki, Allah ya jikan su da rahama, da aljanna ta zama makomarsu; osu alfarmar Annabi Muhammad (SAW) na da wahayi!
output.disgust: Inna lilahi wa inna ilaihi raji'un! Abu ne mai ban tausayi wanda ke jawo ruwan zafi. Allah ya jikan su da rahama, ya sa aljanna ta zama makomarsu tare da alfarmar Annabi Muhammad (SAW).
